  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SupplierOnboarding" name="Supplier Onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Need for new supplier identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue request for proposals (RFP)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProposals" name="Receive supplier proposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals on cost, quality and delivery time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitSplit" name="Site visits or interviews needed?" default="Flow_NoVisit">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Visit</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoVisit</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoVisit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectSupplier" name="Select supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateContract" name="Negotiate contract terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Onboard supplier and execute contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Onboarded" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_VisitSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visit" name="Visits or interviews required" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitSplit" targetRef="Task_SiteVisitInterview">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoVisit" name="No visits or interviews" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitSplit" targetRef="Gateway_VisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_SiteVisitInterview" targetRef="Gateway_VisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_NegotiateContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateContract" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="EndEvent_Onboarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
